Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing leave from employment for persons elected to serve in the state legislature.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the granting of leave for legislative duties;and adding a new section to chapter 49.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any person elected to serve in the state legislature who leaveshis or her employment to participate in a regular or speciallegislative session shall be granted a leave of absence from suchemployment for the duration of the regular or special legislativesession. Upon return, such person shall be reinstated to his or heroriginal position or similar position with equivalent pay andaccumulated seniority, retirement, fringe benefits, and other servicecredits, unless the employer's circumstances have so changed as to makeit impossible or unreasonable to do so. A person shall give notice inwriting to his or her employer that he or she is a candidate forlegislative office and may be absent during regular and speciallegislative sessions. This notice must be given by the employee inwriting within thirty days after filing for legislative office. p. 1 HB 2993 (2) This section does not apply to private employers with twentyfive or less employees.
